document: Course Title: Software Development Fundamentals - 1 (15B11CI111). Institute: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology, Noida. Exam: End-Term Examination, 2023 (1st Semester). Max Time: 2 hr. Max Marks: 35.
Q1. Draw flowchart for finding all roots of N quadratic equations (ax^2 + bx + c = 0) and state whether roots are real & equal, real & unequal, or imaginary.
